eda_class_distribution.png: Class distribution of the complete UCI CKD dataset (n = 400; whole-dataset descriptive summary). CKD is the majority and the positive class.
eda_missingness.png: Percentage of missing values per feature in the complete dataset (whole-dataset descriptive summary). The most frequently missing features are red blood cells (38.0%), red blood cell count (32.8%), white blood cell count (26.5%).
eda_missing_per_record_train.png: Number of missing values per record in the training set, by class. Non-CKD records are mostly complete while CKD records often have several missing values, so missingness itself carries class information (training records only).
eda_numeric_distributions.png: Distributions of the eleven continuous features over all records with a recorded value (whole-dataset descriptive summary; no class information).
eda_categorical_distributions.png: Counts of each recorded level of the ordinal and binary features, with missing values shown in grey (whole-dataset descriptive summary; no class information).
eda_class_differences_train.png: Continuous features by class in the training set (n = 320; observed values only). Boxes show the median and inter-quartile range. Differences describe association in this sample, not causation.
eda_correlation_train.png: Spearman rank correlations between numeric and ordinal features in the training set (pairwise complete observations); values with |r| >= 0.5 are printed. The strongest pairs are haemoglobin and packed cell volume (r = 0.87); packed cell volume and red blood cell count (r = 0.77).
test_confusion_matrices.png: Confusion matrices of the four frozen pipelines on the held-out test set (n = 80: 50 CKD, 30 non-CKD) at the default threshold of 0.5. Rows are true classes, columns predicted classes.
test_roc_curves.png: Receiver operating characteristic curves of the four frozen pipelines on the held-out test set, with CKD as the positive class. Line styles distinguish the models; the dotted diagonal is chance.
test_pr_curves.png: Precision-recall curves on the held-out test set with CKD as the positive class; AP is average precision. The dotted line is the precision of a classifier with no skill (test-set prevalence).
cv_vs_test_auc.png: ROC-AUC of each tuned model in 5-fold cross-validation on the training set (mean +/- standard deviation over folds) and on the held-out test set (point estimate with 95% stratified bootstrap interval).
shap_global_importance.png: Global SHAP importance of the selected model: mean absolute SHAP value of each feature over the 80 held-out test records, in units of probability of CKD. Only the top 12 features are shown.
shap_beeswarm.png: SHAP summary (beeswarm) plot for the selected model on the 80 held-out test records. Each dot is one record; its horizontal position is that feature's contribution to the probability of CKD, and its colour is the feature value (red = high, blue = low; for binary features red = the condition shown in brackets). Positive values push the prediction towards CKD.
shap_dependence.png: SHAP dependence plots for the four most important features (test set). The vertical axis is the contribution to the probability of CKD; the horizontal axis is the feature value in clinical units after imputation. Crosses mark values that were missing and filled with the training median or mode.
shap_waterfall_typical_ckd_26.png: SHAP waterfall plot for a typical correctly classified CKD record (record 26). Starting from the baseline (mean probability of CKD over the training background), red bars push the output towards CKD and blue bars towards non-CKD; the bars sum exactly to the model output f(x). Values marked 'imputed' were missing and filled by the pipeline.
shap_waterfall_typical_non_ckd_270.png: SHAP waterfall plot for a typical correctly classified non-CKD record (record 270). Starting from the baseline (mean probability of CKD over the training background), red bars push the output towards CKD and blue bars towards non-CKD; the bars sum exactly to the model output f(x). Values marked 'imputed' were missing and filled by the pipeline.
shap_waterfall_borderline_324.png: SHAP waterfall plot for the test record whose CKD probability is closest to the 0.5 threshold (record 324). Starting from the baseline (mean probability of CKD over the training background), red bars push the output towards CKD and blue bars towards non-CKD; the bars sum exactly to the model output f(x). Values marked 'imputed' were missing and filled by the pipeline.
cv_roc_curves.png: ROC curves from out-of-fold predictions of the tuned pipelines in 5-fold cross-validation on the 320 training records (axes zoomed to the top-left corner). Every record is scored by a model that did not see it during fitting; the pooled AUC can differ slightly from the mean of per-fold AUCs.
test_score_distributions.png: Predicted CKD probabilities of the four frozen pipelines for the 80 held-out test records, separated by true class (circles: non-CKD, triangles: CKD). Records near the 0.5 threshold are the least certain predictions. Probabilities are model estimates after SMOTENC balancing, not calibrated individual risks.
workflow_diagram.png: Workflow of the proposed system. Blue steps use training records only; the test partition (orange) is locked after the split and used once, for the final evaluation of the frozen pipelines. All preprocessing and SMOTE-NC resampling are refitted inside each cross-validation training fold.
